blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines ranked fifth among countries targeted by Chinese state-sponsored cyber actors, accounting for 2% of their observed global targeting, according to the Microsoft Digital Defense Report 2026. The report identified the Philippines as a significant target in the global cyberthreat landscape, highlighting the country’s exposure to cyber operations linked to geopolitical interests and intelligence gathering. Drawing on Microsoft Threat Intelligence telemetry covering malicious activity observed across its global customer base from July 2025 to June 2026, the report examined the scale and distribution of cyberthreats across countries and regions.
